hook: Skipping your 401(k) match is like turning down a raise.

blocks.narration: Skipping your 401(k) match is like turning down a raise. Many American employers add money when you save. Plenty of workers leave it unclaimed.
blocks.visual: Young office worker at a desk pushes away a glowing envelope stamped with a dollar sign, coworkers in the background, slow push-in

shots.visual: A cartoon office worker with big expressive eyes sits at a desk and frowns at a glowing envelope marked with a dollar sign
shots.action: He shoves the glowing envelope away across the desk with a dismissive flick; camera pushes in on his smug face

shots.visual: A friendly cartoon manager stands beside a giant piggy bank in a bright open office
shots.action: The manager drops a stack of gold coins into the piggy bank and gives a thumbs-up; coins bounce and sparkle

shots.visual: A pile of unopened glowing envelopes on an empty desk at night
shots.action: The envelopes slowly fade and blow away like dust; slow dolly back

blocks.narration: Here is how it works. If your company matches fifty percent up to six percent, saving six percent gets you three percent extra.
blocks.visual: Two stacks of coins grow side by side on a paycheck, the second stack labeled 'match' rises halfway as fast, bold numbers 6% and 3% pop in

shots.visual: Close-up of the cartoon worker's paycheck lying on a desk, two empty glass jars beside it
shots.action: The camera tilts up from the paycheck to the two jars as a spotlight switches on

shots.visual: The left glass jar fills with gold coins from a slot above
shots.action: Coins pour into the left jar and stop at the middle line; the right jar starts filling at half speed

shots.visual: The cartoon worker holds both full jars, grinning
shots.action: He lifts the jars overhead in triumph as confetti falls; camera orbits around him

blocks.narration: On a sixty thousand dollar salary, that is eighteen hundred dollars a year. Check your benefits portal. Follow for one money rule a day.
blocks.visual: Calendar pages flip while a jar labeled 'retirement' fills with coins, ending on a phone screen showing a benefits portal checkbox being ticked

shots.visual: A cartoon salary slip floats in front of a city skyline at sunset
shots.action: The slip spins toward the camera and unfolds

shots.visual: A tall stack of gold coins on a table, the cartoon worker peeking over it
shots.action: The coin stack grows taller with each beat; the worker's eyes widen

shots.visual: A smartphone in a cartoon hand showing a simple green checkbox on a blank screen
shots.action: The thumb taps the checkbox, which fills green with a satisfying bounce; camera pushes in

cta: Follow for one money rule a day.
visual_style: Stylized 3D animated film look, Pixar-quality expressive cartoon characters, bold saturated colors, clean simple backgrounds, soft studio lighting

captions.hook_line: Your 401(k) match is a raise you might be skipping 💸
captions.body: If your employer matches contributions, saving at least up to the match is the easiest return you'll ever get. Look up your plan's match formula today.
captions.comment_prompt: Did you know the match counts as part of your pay?
